SelectionProject.title: SelectionProject
SelectionProject.description: A concept selection project tracking stages, criteria, and evaluation decisions.

title.description: The title of the concept selection project.

description.description: Optional engineering scope or description of the selection exercise.

ownerId.description: The UID of the engineer or facilitator who created the project.

currentStage.description: The active workflow stage ID in the NEXA concept selection process.

ProjectCriterion.title: ProjectCriterion
ProjectCriterion.description: A project-defined selection criterion with weight and focus description.

projectId.description: ID of the parent selection project.

name.description: The name of the criterion (e.g. Technical Feasibility).

weight.description: Weight percentage allocated to this criterion (0-100).

/projects/{projectId}.description: Collection of concept selection projects owned by engineers.

/projects/{projectId}/criteria/{criterio.description: Subcollection of custom selection criteria defined for a project.
